ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the left side is the United States, and soybean production areas are shown in black, mainly concentrated in the central-eastern United States, from south of the Great Lakes to the Mississippi River basin area. Beside it is marked the latitude line of about 40°N, and most of the black areas are near 40°N and to its south. The right side is Brazil, and soybean production areas are shown in black, mainly distributed in areas such as central and southern Brazil, overall located in the middle- and low-latitude zone south of the equator to near the Tropic of Capricorn and its vicinity. Reasoning: The U.S. soybean production areas are mainly near 40°N and to its south, and Brazil's soybean production areas are also located in the low-latitude to middle-latitude range, so the soybean production areas of the two countries are both located in middle and low latitudes. In middle- and low-latitude areas, solar radiation is relatively strong and heat conditions are relatively good, so the common heat condition is sufficient heat.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中美国、巴西大豆产区的黑色分布范围，再借助图上40°N等纬度提示判断它们都位于中、低纬度。最后用“中低纬地区太阳辐射较强、热量条件较好”的规律，得出共同热量条件为热量充足。
